quote: For this game to be 30fps, digital only, content paywalled, bloated, unoptimized, glitchy, and Rockstar blacklisting journalists who don't give them perfect scores in 2026 is absolutely embarrassing.

author: solarsaturn9
quote: Deserving of the reverence it commands in gaming history. This remake improves upon the original title and the 3DS remaster in nearly every way possible. The puppet inspired character designs fit the original concept art spectacularly and allows the art direction to stand out from the generic anime influenced designs that saturate the market these days.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: solarsaturn9
quote: This game is an excellent nod to the original while still maintaining the wonder of Ocarina of Time. There are a few annoyances but the brilliance far outweighs weapon durability. The fact that reviewers are rating this game 0 just to drag the score down is ridiculous. This game is nowhere near deserving a 0.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

author: solarsaturn9
quote: This game is addictive and has a ridiculous amount of replay value. However, this game has it's fair share of problems. The locales get a little old after a while. I wish they would have designed each battlefield in different color schemes at different times of day for Adventure mode. This way they could have paired different skyboxes with different battlefield color schemes to at least make some locales feel new. Some of the grunts and captains in adventure mode get old as well. If they would have added new races for those such as Deku scrubs or Zoras just to make things feel new every once in a while, it would have been great. These are very minor critiques though.
